# MyTokenWallet

> MyTokenWallet is a self-custody wallet website with wallet safety information, asset guides, and an educational journal.

## Main pages

- [Home](/): Product overview and app preview.
- [Wallet download](/wallet-download): iOS and Android setup details.
- [Security](/security): Self-custody and wallet safety.
- [Asset operations](/asset-operations): Information about sending, receiving, and exploring assets.
- [Explore](/explore): Introductory digital asset topics.
- [Journal](/blog): Published guides and updates.

## Discovery

- [XML sitemap](/sitemap.xml): Current public pages and published articles.
- [Text sitemap](/sitemap.txt): Plain text list of public page URLs.
